questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the correct form of the verb in brackets: By the time we arrived, the concert _____ for half an hour.
Which sentence correctly reports the meaning of: 'I am sure that I will pass my exam'?
options: He said that he was sure to pass his exam.
He said that he was sure that he would pass his exam.
He said that he was sure that he will pass his exam.
He said that he was sure that he would have passed his exam.
questions.answer: He said that he was sure that he would pass his exam.

questions.question: Choose the correct reported speech form: 'If I find her address, I'll send her an invitation.'
options: He said that if he found her address, he would send her an invitation.
He said that if he found her address, he would have sent her an invitation.
He said that if he had found her address, he would send her an invitation.
He said that if he had found her address, he would have sent her an invitation.
questions.answer: He said that if he found her address, he would send her an invitation.

questions.question: Select the correct option to complete the sentence: The manager insisted that the employees _____ overtime without payment.
Which of these sentences correctly uses a discourse marker to express concession?
options: Although I'm tired, I'll go to the gym.
Even though I'm tired, I'll go to the gym.
In spite of being tired, I'll go to the gym.
Despite being tired, I'll go to the gym.
questions.answer: Although I'm tired, I'll go to the gym.

questions.question: Choose the correct collocation: 'She gave a _____ explanation of the situation.'

Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice to report the discovery?
options: It is believed that the ancient ruins date back to the Roman era.
It is believed that the ancient ruins are dating back to the Roman era.
It is believed that the ancient ruins were dating back to the Roman era.
It is believed that the ancient ruins have been dating back to the Roman era.
questions.answer: It is believed that the ancient ruins date back to the Roman era.
